title: Code and data for First Steps Towards a Runtime Analysis When Starting With a Good Solution
author: Antipov, Denis
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Extract archive files
steps.instruction: Download the file "generic-onell.zip" and unzip it into a working directory.

steps.title: Run build script
steps.instruction: Execute the Python script build.py with the required arguments to produce figures and p‑value tables for each dataset.

substeps.instruction: python build.py onemax-sqrt.tex onemax-sqrt.sig n onemax-sqrt.json
python build.py onemax-log.tex onemax-log.sig n onemax-log.json
python build.py onemax-etc.tex onemax-etc.sig d onemax-1to21-unlimited.json onemax-1to14-limited.json

steps.title: Locate generated outputs
steps.instruction: Find the generated .tex figure source files (onemax-sqrt.tex, onemax-log.tex, onemax-etc.tex) and the .sig p‑value tables (onemax-sqrt.sig, onemax-log.sig, onemax-etc.sig) in the working directory.
